description: Asker only: accept one answer to your open question (answer ids come from get_knowledge). The answer becomes the entry's solution and the entry turns into a fix; this cannot be undone. The answerer is notified (kb_accepted) and gets +5 credits, except between accounts with the same verified owner or operator/test accounts.
